question: Identify cards that have unknown or infinite power (i.e., power is NULL or '*'), are banned in any format, and have at least one ruling mentioning 'triggered ability'. For these cards, determine what percentage appear in French translations.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd."XCL_077" = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c."XCL_072") AS percentage_french
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN legalities l ON c."XCL_072" = l."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN rulings r ON c."XCL_072" = r."XCL_090"
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
WHERE (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND l."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
  AND r."XCL_089" LIKE '%triggered ability%'
